body:
Greg's direction (Advisor #1286, 2026-10-19 19:19Z), verbatim: "finish the native remote mailbox now (M4→M6), then use it as the operational control channel to finish Engram sync. Prioritize native two-way remote delivery and the first M6 central↔Mac proof; retain the prompt/transcript path only as a temporary bridge until native evidence passes." Earlier, #1266 and #1268: the remote mailbox is the operational control channel for Git-folder export, merge and import, ownership and handoffs; it is not SQLite replication or a global claim lock. Coordinator consequences: remote-path slices go first for gates, warms and people; non-remote lanes yield when they contend. The temporary bridge for remote sessions is the central host's POST /api/sessions/{id}/messages with sourceSessionId (attributed), with results read from the session transcript; termal_send_to_session refuses remote targets.

Earlier governing decision, preserved before retiring the Oct17 queue snapshots: Engram::Advisor, TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #1065, 2026-10-17 20:39:43Z, quoted verbatim in epic w-93105e5592c0 note3490235e0303443aaf02204fbe45eeb9 (full read; Engram::Fable second-reader requested preservation in mailbox-message-9d84a308-35e2-4d3f-b89c-eb75140c9c14): 'Greg odrzuca T1/T2 ograniczenie jako model docelowy. Jego nowy kierunek: remote ma być first-class citizen. Konkretnie: (1) mailbox ma działać zdalnie między hostami dla normalnej koordynacji, nie tylko poprzez operator relay; (2) Engram ma mieć osobny mechanizm synchronizacji między hostami. Operator relay jest tylko tymczasowym fallbackiem. Utwórz dwa wyraźne root items/epics z zależnością i zleć wspólny design Architect1+2: transport mailboxa, tożsamość/authority/dedup/recovery oraz Engram sync boundary/conflict semantics. Nie ograniczaj projektu do jednokierunkowego courier. Nie wdrażaj jeszcze kodu przed wspólnym projektem i rozbiciem na małe slice'y.'

The rejected alternatives are defined in w-7e947cec3d91 note8cc09c7afd9d476ca501191f544f0795: T1 meant B as SSH executor of A's control plane, mailbox and credit routed under the remote-access contract; T2 meant B as an independent host limited to a one-way typed-report courier, with operator relay as its interim default. Greg rejected those limits as the target. These task records retain the original decision and design sequence; this preservation grants no new action or revival of obsolete queue GOs. The later Oct19 native-mailbox direction above remains separately sourced.

Earlier lasting priority preserved from Fable2's termal-window32-2026-10-18 r11, 20:38Z, attributed to Advisor #1177: prioritize the M series plus A1 for real remote operation, optimize for multi-host work and less coordinator ceremony. This is Fable2's paraphrase, not recovered verbatim Greg wording; the contemporaneous watchdog-temporary and enrollment sequencing details are spent working state. The original #1177 wording remains to be recovered if needed. The opening paragraph's statement that termal_send_to_session refused remote targets describes its Oct19 implementation state only; current supported native remote mail follows AGENTS host guidance and the exact authenticated pair/identity route, with original message/key/route retained on unresolved retries. No new relay, route switch, send, enrollment, install or restart permission is created by this preservation.
